dogecoin.text: Circa 2014 I bought the heaviest-duty printer paper I could find, and made ten Dogecoin paper wallets, each containing 1 million DOGE. Somewhere between 0 and 10 of those wallets are in a safety deposit box I can't access right now.

@2Yeahyeah @pauliusuza @beaniemaxi @digitalartchick @Coldie @Goltra @Hackatao It’s the same thesis as Right Click. You like that one over other XCOPY pieces because the community has adopted it as a meme. Dogecoin, Punks, Mona Lisa...it’s all the same stuff.
